title: Replay Vision state-write activities share STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY / STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE from constants.py
answers: what retry policy should a replay vision state write activity use
how long do observation state writes retry
where is the scan workflow retry policy defined
body:
Short Postgres writes that move an observation or its media between states use products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/constants.py:STATE_ACTIVITY_RETRY (1s initial, 10s max interval, 5 attempts, about 15s of backoff) together with STATE_ACTIVITY_SCHEDULE_TO_CLOSE (3 min). Used in workflow.py:ApplyScannerWorkflow and media_workflow.py:ObservationMediaWorkflow.
maximum_attempts is what ends the chain. The 3-minute schedule_to_close is a ceiling, sized so the failure path fits inside APPLY_SCANNER_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. It is not meant to ride out a multi-minute Postgres outage.
Convention: import the shared constants. Don't define a private per-workflow policy for state writes. Activities with special error semantics keep their own policies (_CREATE_OBSERVATION_RETRY, _ENSURE_ASSET_RETRY, _THUMBNAIL_RETRY). evaluation_workflow.py still has its own policy (left out of scope).
Nothing retries a lost thumbnail later, because #105099 removed the backfill sweep. The media workflow's retries are the only chance.
Per the PR, changing retry policies is Temporal-replay safe: they are not part of the determinism check, and activities already scheduled keep their old policy.
applies: Temporal workflows in products/replay_vision/backend/temporal scheduling state-transition activities
